labels.name: Amelia
labels.function: Entire limb missing; bud suppressed early in week 4

labels.name: Meromelia
labels.function: Limb partly missing; growth arrested in week 5

labels.name: Phocomelia
labels.function: Proximal long bones absent; hand attached at the trunk

labels.name: Polydactyly
labels.function: Often from ectopic SHH in the ZPA; dominant trait

labels.name: Syndactyly
labels.function: Fused adjacent digits; common in trisomy 21

labels.name: Split-hand malformation
labels.function: Central digital rays fail to form; autosomal dominant

labels.name: Amniotic band
labels.function: Torn-amnion strands that constrict or amputate digits

labels.name: Acetabulum
labels.function: Deep socket that normally covers the ball of the femur

labels.name: Femoral head
labels.function: Ball centered in the socket; stays reduced in a Pavlik harness

labels.name: Dysplastic acetabulum
labels.function: Shallow, underdeveloped socket; linked to breech posture

labels.name: Dislocated femoral head
labels.function: Displaced out of the socket; Ortolani clunk relocates it

labels.name: Joint capsule
labels.function: Very relaxed at birth, letting the joint dislocate

labels.name: Asymmetric thigh folds
labels.function: Uneven creases on the affected side; a screening clue

labels.name: Achilles tendon
labels.function: Cut (tenotomy) in the Ponseti method to correct equinus

labels.name: Talipes equinovarus
labels.function: Foot inverted with sole facing medially; twice as common in males

labels.function: Cartilage growth zone; thin and bridged by bone in FGFR3 dwarfism

labels.name: Metaphysis
labels.function: Flares into an Erlenmeyer flask shape in marble bone disease

labels.name: Medullary cavity
labels.function: Filled by persistent primary spongiosa in osteopetrosis

labels.name: Proliferating zone
labels.function: Stacked dividing chondrocytes that FGFR3 normally brakes

labels.name: Osteoclast
labels.function: Monocyte-derived resorbing cell; fails in osteopetrosis

labels.name: Resorption pit
labels.function: Acidified via carbonic anhydrase II to dissolve hydroxyapatite

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Bone-forming cell; secretes the collagen defective in OI

labels.name: Type I collagen
labels.function: COL1A1/COL1A2 product; reduced or abnormal in brittle bones
